# Community Code of Conduct

Please see the official
[Ansible Community Code of Conduct](https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/latest/community/code_of_conduct.html).

All contributors, maintainers, and participants in the `vastdata.vms`
collection community are expected to adhere to this Code of Conduct in all
project spaces (issues, merge/pull requests, discussions, and any other
communication channels).

To report a violation, contact the maintainers at
[ansible@vastdata.com](mailto:ansible@vastdata.com). Reports will be handled
confidentially.
